entries.note: Requires live DB and YADGAR_TEST_LIVE_SCAN=1 env var; CI does not set this
launchd install — macOS-only feature; covers all 3 macOS skips in this file
uninstall launchd cleanup path — macOS-only feature, cannot run on Linux CI
podman machine socket resolution — macOS-only feature, cannot run on Linux CI

test requires shellcheck binary; CI image (python:3.14-slim) does not include it
T7 — investigation showed backend does not require YADGAR_DB_USER; test body is pass by design

Documents v5.46.7 regression: daemon unconditionally uses YADGAR_CI_BRANCH as branch fallback. Fix is test-side in other tests (monkeypatch.delenv). Cannot be exercised in CI where YADGAR_CI_BRANCH=master is set globally.

Regen-on-demand skip by design. Fixture committed at yadgar/tests/backend/fixtures/causal_discovery_expected.json (Car 2: generated INSIDE the yadgar-ci container — scipy FP sensitivity across BLAS builds). Regenerate only inside the CI container; command in the test module docstring.
duckdb is an optional dep not included in [test] extras or CI image (python:3.14-slim). All 18 duckdb skips are covered by this entry.
nix binary absent in CI container; flake checks run on dev machines (NixOS). Stays a skip — nix-in-container is unreasonable weight.
Regen-on-demand skip by design. Fixture committed at yadgar/tests/core/fixtures/retrieval_core_expected.json.
Linked-worktree detection tests build a real git repo + worktree fixture; skipped only where git is absent (never in CI — checkout requires git)

entries.reason_pattern: node not in PATH (opencode plugin smoke; loads the emitted yadgar-hooks.ts via Node 24 --experimental-strip-types)
entries.note: Car A opencode hook port: the smoke catches template drift that the unit tests don't (e.g. accidental runtime import of @opencode-ai/plugin, missing event handler, fabricated ctx.client MCP RPC). CI image (Python 3.14 + build chain) doesn't ship node; local dev / pre-merge runs the smoke.
